## Goal
Reimplement the model-policy work from a simpler fresh design instead of iterating further on PR #337.

## Context
- Source request: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/337#issuecomment-4525794383
- Existing PR: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/337
- Parent issue: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/336
- Original goal was to let Sepo users configure default provider/model/reasoning settings via a JSON policy while preserving `AGENT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER` compatibility.
- The implementation should keep reviewer lanes fixed; only review synthesis and single-agent routes should consume the policy.
- PR #337 went through several follow-up fixes: display config was simplified to `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL`, Codex reasoning effort was fixed for `session_policy: none`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` support was restored, and the resolver shell trampoline was removed. The requester is concerned the accumulated result may be overcomplicated and asked for a from-scratch version.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Produce a simpler implementation for configurable agent model policy that satisfies issue #336 without carrying over unnecessary complexity from PR #337.
- Preserve existing provider behavior, including `AGENT_DEFAULT_PROVIDER`, auto-detection, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` support.
- Support provider/model/reasoning defaults and route overrides for single-agent routes and review synthesis.
- Do not make reviewer lanes dynamically configurable or change the fixed Claude/Codex review matrix.
- Keep display metadata controlled only by `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL`, defaulting off.
- Ensure Codex reasoning effort reaches ACPX correctly, including exec runs with `session_policy: none`; ensure Claude reasoning effort maps through the existing Claude effort environment path.
- Keep provider/model resolution usable before `.agent/dist`, TypeScript compilation, or npm install are available.
- Update focused docs and tests for resolver behavior, ACPX/run wiring, display footer behavior, workflow envelope changes, and compatibility paths.
- Run the relevant build/tests and `git diff --check`.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/337

**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-340/codex-26336493584`
- Pull request: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/341

Rebuilt configurable model policy support on a clean branch: provider resolution now uses a plain pre-runtime Node resolver for AGENT_MODEL_POLICY plus AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL, resolved model/effort values are threaded through workflows/run-agent-task/acpx, reviewer lanes remain fixed, Codex exec reasoning uses transient sessions when needed, and Claude effort maps through CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL. Verified with npm --prefix .agent run build, focused node --test suites, and git diff --check.
